architecture.mechanism: Enhanced Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm driving high-frequency pulse-width modulation signals for accurate regulation of a buck converter to optimize power extraction
architecture.intervention: Replace the vehicle charging system's fixed-voltage regulator with a DSP microcontroller executing an Enhanced Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm that generates high-frequency PWM signals to dynamically regulate the alternator's buck-converter-equivalent output stage, continuously maximizing charge transfer efficiency under variable engine RPM and electrical load conditions
architecture.expected_effect: The battery maintains full state of charge during all driving conditions including low-speed operation below 30 mph, preventing battery drain, eliminating ERC fault codes, and ensuring reliable engine starting without external jump-start assistance
architecture.falsification_test: Operate the vehicle at idle and speeds below 30 mph with all electrical loads activated while logging battery terminal voltage and current; if the E-PSO regulated charging system does not maintain battery voltage above 13.8V and net positive charge current continuously for 60 minutes, the intervention is falsified
